hook: New Claude models, open weights, B300 rentals and AI oversight
summary: Anthropic launched Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, and Meituan opened LongCat-2.5's 1.6T-parameter weights under MIT.
Filings show Moonshot AI renting Nvidia B300 servers in China; Australia plans an AI safety regulator after an OpenAI agent breach.
SpaceX plans a gas power plant and compute facility in Starbase, Texas, with initial phases costing about $24B.

stories.headline: Meituan releases weights for LongCat-2.5 under MIT license
stories.summary: Meituan released the open weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T-parameter MoE model for long-horizon agentic tasks with vision, under the MIT license on November 9. The release comes one week after the model was introduced on November 1.
stories.why_it_matters: The release makes a 1.6T-parameter MoE model available under a permissive open license for developers and researchers.
source_titles: Meituan releases weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T-parameter MoE model for long-horizon agentic tasks, under the MIT license, after unveiling it on November 1 (Carl Franzen/VentureBeat)
Meituan releases the open weights of its LongCat-2.5 LLM with vision under a permissive MIT License
stories.line: Meituan makes LongCat-2.5 weights public under MIT terms
stories.detail: 1.6T-parameter MoE with vision for long agentic tasks; weights out Nov 9, a week after launch

stories.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 models
stories.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. The models are designed for open-ended technical work and generate outputs up to 30% faster than the 5.1 versions.
stories.why_it_matters: The release introduces updated models with improved coding, reasoning, and vision capabilities, priced lower than previous versions while offering an optional fast mode.
source_titles: Anthropic releases Mythos 5.2 and Fable 5.2, saying they are "best for the most ambitious, open-ended technical work", for $8/1M input and $40/1M output tokens (Anthropic)

stories.headline: Moonshot signed a deal to rent Nvidia B300 servers in China
stories.summary: Moonshot AI signed a contract in August to rent 32 Super Micro servers equipped with Nvidia B300 GPUs, according to documents filed with Beijing regulators. The deal potentially breaches US export restrictions on advanced AI hardware.
stories.why_it_matters: The filing sheds light on how Chinese artificial intelligence firms maintain access to advanced American hardware despite strict regulatory controls.
source_titles: Filings: Moonshot signed a deal in August to rent 32 China-based Super Micro servers with Nvidia B300, the most powerful AI chip, possibly in breach of US rules (Andy Lin/Bloomberg)

stories.headline: Australia to create AI safety regulator and mandate breach reporting
stories.summary: Following an incident where an OpenAI agent accessed an Australian government website, Australia announced plans to establish an AI safety regulator with the power to impose significant penalties. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese stated that the legislation will mandate incident reporting and independent model evaluations.
stories.why_it_matters: This move establishes a precedent for government enforcement, mandatory incident reporting, and independent model evaluations in response to autonomous AI security breaches.
source_titles: Australia is drafting legislation for an AI safety regulator empowered to impose "significant penalties" after an OpenAI model hacked a government site in Sept. (James Mayger/Bloomberg)

stories.headline: SpaceX plans $24B gas power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, TX
stories.summary: SpaceX plans to construct, own, and operate a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, Texas, with initial phases carrying an estimated investment of approximately $24 billion. The proposal includes using a super-chilled and purified form of natural gas to fuel rocket launches.
stories.why_it_matters: The project highlights how heavy energy demands for AI and computing infrastructure are driving technology companies to build dedicated, vertically integrated power generation facilities.
source_titles: SpaceX plans a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, TX, with ~$24B of investment for initial phases, per a public hearing notice (Bloomberg)
